book.name: Jon
book.title: Jon Jisas Krais Manö Aij u Jon kalɨ kƚiñ rɨka

content: Maria Jisas nɨp wel haƚɨŋ aij auep lɨ ña
Pasopa nan ñɨŋnɨg gɨla u, ñɨn unbö kagoƚ jɨŋ u nöp mɨdö nɨŋöl gɨ, Jisas Lasaras uma nɨp gö uraka ram nɨpe u ara. Ram rɨƚɨg agƚö anɨbu hib Bedani.
Bedani amöm, nan ñɨŋun, a göm, Jisas u, Lasaras u, nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap abe, asɨk mɨdeila nɨŋöm, Mada nan magö gau nɨme la.
Nɨñɨn Maria pen, wel haƚɨŋ aij mani kub yabɨƚ raubal barol ap dapöm, Jisas ma adö u hoŋ gɨ ñöm, umagö nɨpe u udöm ma nɨpe ƚɨƚɨ ga. Anɨg geia, wel haƚɨŋ aij anɨbu, ram raul anɨbu magöŋhalö haƚɨŋ ara.
Anɨg geia, Judas Iskariod, Jisas bɨ nɨpe au nɨp hainö mumug nɨŋa bɨ anɨbu, haƚɨŋ aij anɨbu nɨŋöm haga,
“Mani kub yabɨƚ raubal wel anɨbi rö yuöm, mani udöm, nɨbi bɨ nan mɨdagöp gau kalɨp ñɨböp u aij. Bɨ wel anɨb rö raunɨg gab u, nɨpe rakɨn unbö sɨduŋ laŋ wög göm mani udöm amöm wel anɨbi raunab,” a ga.
Nɨpe anɨg haga u, nɨbi bɨ nan mɨdagöp gau mög nɨŋöm hagaga; nɨpe mani wadɨ u ud ajöm, rɨmnap agamɨj si udmɨdöp u me anɨg haga.
Pen Jisas haga, “Nɨp hag gagmön. Yɨp rɨgöl gɨnaböl ñɨn u lɨ ñɨnɨg dap löp u, uri dap lɨ ñöb.
Nɨbi bɨ mani mɨdagöp gau aip pör mɨdeinabim; pen yad aip pör mɨdageinabim,” a ga.
Lasaras nɨp agamɨj alun, a gɨla
Jisas Bedani ap mɨdöp a gɨla manö anɨbu nɨŋöm, Juda nɨbi bɨ iru nöp gau nɨp nɨŋnɨg arla. Pen Jisas nɨp nöp nɨŋnɨg aragla; Lasaras bɨ uma Jisas gö uraka bɨ anɨbu nɨp abe nɨŋnɨg arla.

Pen Lasaras uma Jisas nɨp gö uraka rö, Juda nɨbi bɨ iru nöp nagɨ adö kale gɨ mɨdmɨdal u arö göm, Jisas nɨp nɨŋ udla. Anɨg geila, bɨ God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub gau, Lasaras nɨp abe alnabun, a göm gasɨ u nɨŋla.
Jisas kiŋ rö Jerusalem ara
Ruö, nɨbi bɨ iru yabɨƚ Pasopa nan ñɨŋnɨg aula gau, Jisas Jerusalem auab a gɨla manö anɨbu nɨŋöm,
nɨp am nɨŋun, a göm, galon uɫaŋ rɨk dap löl gɨ, wɨñ kub alöl gɨ hagla,

content.text: “Bɨ Kub hib nɨpe u hagno adö araŋ!”
“Bɨ Kub nɨpe Bɨ nɨpe anɨbi yuö auöp me i!”
“Nɨpe Bɨ aij. Hib nɨpe hagno adö araŋ!”
“Nɨpe Isrel Kiŋ auab me i! Hib nɨpe hagno adö araŋ!”

content: Jisas kaj donki marep ap udöm, adö anɨbu asɨköm areia. Anɨg ga u, God Manö u kalɨ kƚiñ rɨköm hagla rö nöp ga. God Manö adɨŋ anɨbu kalɨ kƚiñ rɨköm hagla,

content.text: Kiŋ ne u kaj donki marep adö u asɨköm auab,” a gɨla.

content: Ga ñɨn anɨbu, Jisas bɨ nɨpe gau, God nɨpe anɨg gɨnab a ga rö nöp gab u a göm nɨŋagla; pen hainö Jisas umöm uraköm, God ram mɨnöŋ kumi kabö adö laŋ au hadö ara ñɨn anɨbu nöp, Jisas bɨ nɨpe gau gasɨ nɨŋ aij göm nɨŋla, Jisas Jerusalem araia ñɨn anɨbu nan nɨhön nɨhön nɨp gɨla gau, nöd God manö hagep bɨ gau God Manö kalɨ kƚiñ rɨköm hagla rö nöp gɨla.
Jisas Lasaras uma nɨp gö uraka u, nɨbi bɨ nɨŋöl mɨdeila gau manö anɨbu hag amɨl apɨl gɨ mɨdeila.
Anɨb u, nɨbi bɨ iru nöp nan gagep ga anɨbu nɨŋöm, Jerusalem arö göm, nɨp adan aŋ au nɨŋnɨg arla.
Kale anɨg gɨla rö, bɨ Perisi gau nɨŋöm, kale ke nöp manö hagöm hagla, “Nɨŋim! Hon nan ap gun rö lagöp. Nɨbi bɨ mɨnöŋ naböŋ iƚ i magöŋhalö bɨ anɨbu nɨp hain gaböl,” a gɨla.
Grik nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap Jisas nɨp nɨŋnɨg arla
Pen Pasopa ñɨn u auab, a göm, God nɨp sabe gɨnɨg Jerusalem arla ñɨn anɨbu, Grik nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap aip arla.
Grik nɨbi bɨ anɨb gau apöm, Pilip ram mɨnöŋ Galili au Bedsaida daun nɨbö bɨ u nɨp hagla, “Bɨ kub nɨŋeb, hon Jisas nɨp nɨŋun,” a gɨla.
Anɨg hageila, Pilip am Edru nɨp hag ñöm, Edru aip mɨhöŋgöl ammil Jisas nɨp hag ñɨlö.
Hag ñailö, Jisas haga, “Mɨñi God gö, Bɨ Ñɨ nɨpe Bɨ mailö aij ke halö mɨdöp u nɨŋnaböl ñɨn u hadö auöp.
Yad kalöp nɨŋö yabɨƚ hagabin, wid magö ap mɨnöŋ yaŋ lugöm umagnab u, yɨharɨŋ wid magö añɨ ap nöp mɨdeinab. Pen wid magö anɨbu mɨnöŋ yaŋ lugöm umeinab u, hainö ranöm magö iru nöp pɨlnab.

Nɨbi bɨ an, ‘Mɨnöŋ naböŋ iƚ i kamɨŋ mɨdep magö yad ke nöp gasɨ nɨŋem mɨd aij gɨnam,’ a göm gö arnab u, nɨpe umöm böŋ nöp umnab; pen nɨbi bɨ an, ‘Mɨnöŋ naböŋ iƚ i kamɨŋ mɨdep magö yad ke gasɨ iru nɨŋagnam; mɨd aij gɨnabin aka mɨd aij gagnabin u nan kub wasö,’ a göm gö arnab u kamɨŋ mɨdep magö nɨpe u pör nöp pör nöp mɨdeinab.

Pen nɨbi bɨ an yɨp wög gɨnɨg gɨnabin a gɨnab u, nɨpe yɨp hain gɨnɨm; yad gai mɨdeinabin u, nɨbi bɨ wög gɨ ñeb yad aip mɨdeinab. Nɨbi bɨ an wög yad gɨ ñɨnab, Bapi yad nɨbi bɨ anɨbu hib nɨpe u dap rannab.
Jisas, “Umnabin,” a ga
“Mɨñi yɨp marö gab u nɨhön hagnam? ‘Bapi yɨp rarö rauö, yɨp nan nɨhön gɨnɨg gab u gagnɨm,’ a gem hagnam aka? Wasö! Marö anɨbu udnɨg aunö.

Pen Bapi, ne gö nɨbi bɨ gau nɨŋnaböl, ne Bɨ mailö aij ke halö mɨdpan,” a ga. Jisas anɨg hagö nɨŋöl gɨ, manö ap kumi kabö adö laŋ nɨbö apöm haga, “Yad gɨnö, nɨbi bɨ gau hadö nɨŋbal yad Bɨ mailö aij ke halö mɨdpin. Pen yad kauyaŋ gɨnö, nɨbi bɨ gau kauyaŋ nɨŋnaböl,” a ga.
Pen nɨbi bɨ mɨdeila gau, God manö haga anɨbu nɨŋöm, rɨmnap hagla, “Rɨmu hagajɨp,” a gɨla; rɨmnap pen hagla, “Ejol ap Jisas nɨp manö rɨmnap hagajɨp,” a gɨla.
Anɨg hagla u pen Jisas kalɨp haga, “Manö hagajɨp anɨbu yɨp nan a göm hagagöp; kalöp nan a göm hagajɨp.

Pen nɨhön: mɨñi nɨbi bɨ mɨnöŋ naböŋ iƚ i gau, kale nɨhön nɨhön gɨpal u, God nɨpe ke nɨŋöm, pen ñöm, kale balu ke ke lɨnab. Nɨbi bɨ mɨnöŋ naböŋ iƚ i yɨp nɨŋ udagpal gau kalɨp kiŋ rö abad mɨdöp bɨ naij anɨbu, God nɨp rɨdɨk gɨ yunab.
Yɨp ud adö au laŋ leinaböl u, yad nɨbi bɨ ram mɨnöŋ ke gau nɨbö magöŋhalö ɫɨp gɨ dam udnabin,” a ga.
Jisas manö haga anɨbu, yɨp aige göl gɨlö umnabin, a göm, haga.

Pen nɨbi bɨ iru nöp ap mɨdeila anɨb gau Jisas nɨp pen hagla, “Lo manö hon u hagöp, ‘Krais u pör pör nöp kamɨŋ mɨdeinab,’ a göp u pen ne ai gɨnɨg gɨmön hagabön, ‘Bɨ Ñɨ nɨpe nɨp ud adö au laŋ lɨnaböl,’ a gabön? Pen Bɨ Ñɨ nɨpe a gɨ hagabön u, an nɨp hagabön?” ö gɨla.

Hageila, Jisas haga, “Mailö u pro marap halö kalöp aip mɨdeinab. Anɨb u, mailö kalöp aip mɨdöp magö i, adan aj aij gɨmim; wasö u, sɨb apöm kalöp paƚu gɨnab. Nɨbi bɨ an sɨb au ajeinab, gai arnabin a göm nɨŋagnab.
Mailö kalöp aip mɨdöp magö i, mailö u nɨŋ udmim. Mailö u nɨŋ udeinabim u, mailö ñɨ pai nɨpe lɨnabim,” a ga. Jisas anɨg hagöm, nɨbi bɨ anɨb gau arö göm ke gau aramöm pi göl mɨdeia.
Nɨbi bɨ gau iru nöp Jisas nɨp nɨŋ udagla
Jisas nɨpe nan gagep iru nöp nɨbi bɨ gau amgö ilö adö kale ga nɨŋla pen nɨp nɨŋ udagla.
Nɨbi bɨ Jisas nɨp nɨŋ udagla u, bɨ God manö hagep Aisaia hadame nöp God Manö adɨŋ ap kalɨ kƚiñ rɨköm haga rö nöp gɨla. Nɨpe manö anɨbu kalɨ kƚiñ rɨköm haga,

content.text: “Bɨ Kub, manö aij ne kalɨp hag ñɨbun
pen kale manö anɨbu manö aij a göm udagpal;
ne kƚö ke yabɨƚ ne ke gɨmön gaina u nɨŋbal u
pen nöp Bɨ Kub a göm nɨŋ udagpal,” a ga.

content: Anɨb u, kale Jisas nɨp nɨŋ udagla. Anɨg gɨla u, Aisaia God Manö adɨŋ ap kalɨ kƚiñ rɨköm haga rö nöp gɨla. Nɨpe manö anɨbu kalɨ kƚiñ rɨköm haga,

content.text: “God nɨpe nɨbi bɨ gau kalɨp gö
God nɨpe gö kale gasɨ rɨmɨd aij mɨdagöp.
kale amgö magö nɨŋ aij göm,
gasɨ rɨmɨd nɨŋ aij göm, yɨp aublap,
yad gɨnö kalɨp kamɨŋ lɨböp, a göm ga,” a ga.

content: Adö anɨbu nöp kale Jisas nɨp nɨŋ udöl rö laga.
Aisaia hadame nöp manö haga anɨbu, nɨpe Jisas mailö aij nɨpe u nɨŋöm anɨg haga.

Pen Juda bɨ kub gau kale magöŋhalö Jisas nɨp arö gagla; bɨ kub iru nɨbanö nɨp nɨŋ udla. Pen, bɨ Perisi hanɨp hag yulö hon Juda magum gep ram raul mɨgan u kuöyaŋ arep rö lagnab, a göm me, Jisas nɨŋ udla u waiö hagagla.
Jisas nɨŋ udla u waiö hagagla anɨbu, nɨbi bɨ gau hib hon haglö adö araŋ, a gɨ gasɨ nɨŋöm, anɨg gɨla. Pen nan nɨhön gɨno God nɨŋö, nɨp aij gɨnab a göm, gasɨ anɨbu nɨŋagla.
Jisas manö aij nɨpe u nöp nɨbi bɨ kalɨp manö kub hagnab
Pen Jisas meg magö dap ranöm haga, “Nɨbi bɨ an yɨp nɨŋ udnab u, yɨp nöp wasö, bɨ yɨp hag yuö aunö nɨp abe nɨŋ udnab.
Nɨbi bɨ an yɨp amgö nɨŋnab u, yɨp nöp wasö, bɨ yɨp hag yuö aunö nɨp abe amgö nɨŋnab.
Yad mɨnöŋ naböŋ iƚ i apem nɨbi bɨ gau kalɨp mailö ñabin. Anɨb u, nɨbi bɨ yɨp nɨŋ udnaböl gau, sɨbön aŋ gau mɨdageinaböl.
“Nɨbi bɨ manö yad u nɨŋöm hagabin rö gagnaböl gau, kalɨp manö kub hagagnabin. Pen nɨhön: yad nɨbi bɨ mɨnöŋ naböŋ iƚ i mɨdpal kalɨp manö kub hagnɨg auagnö; kalɨp ud kamɨŋ yunɨg aunö.
Pen nɨbi bɨ yɨp udagöm, manö yad udagnaböl gau, manö kub hagep ñɨn u, manö yad hagpin u nöp kalɨp manö kub hagnab.
Nɨhön gɨnɨg: manö yad hagpin u, ke nɨŋem hagagpin; Bapi yɨp hag yua u, anɨg anɨg hagmön, a göp rö nöp hagpin.
Yad nɨŋbin, manö nɨpe u nɨŋ udeinaböl u, kalɨp pör mɨdep u ñɨnab. Anɨb u, manö yad hagabin u, Bapi manö anɨg anɨg rö hagmön, a göp rö nöp hagabin,” a ga.
